question_text:
Assertion (A) : Global warming is caused due to increasing presence of green house gases
and ozone layer depletion.
Reason (R) :
Global warming is responsible for lowering of sea level.
The correct answer is
(A) 

(R) 

Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
